rules.statement: The District Judge has an inherent power to vacate an erroneous order made ex parte, especially when the absence of a party was due to illness or other circumstances over which he had no control.
rules.supporting_quote: "As a rule, he has power to open or rescind his own orders made, not in ter partes but ex parte. on being satisfied that the order was made to the prejudice of a party who was unable to attend in consequence of illness or other circumstances over which he had no control."
